title: Bookstack (LinuxServer.io)
tagline: A free and open source Wiki designed for creating beautiful documentation. Featuring a simple, but powerful Wysiwyg editor it allows for teams to create detailed and useful documentation with ease. Powered by Sql and including a Markdown editor for those who prefer it, Bookstack is geared towards making documentation more of a pleasure than a chore. For more information on Bookstack visit their website and check it out: https://www. Bookstackapp. Com
